card.name: Adverbs after a verb or modal
card.fires_on: Short adverbs such as easily, thus, therefore, soon, now, or the ending -ly that come right after a verb or modal like can, started, or known. They are mostly in general web prose.

modes.label: Easily after can
modes.description: The adverb easily directly follows the modal can.
modes.example: consumers can<< easily>> drill down to the county level

modes.label: Thus or therefore after a clause
modes.description: A linking adverb comes straight after a verb and introduces a consequence.
modes.example: free levothyroxine may be decreased when estrogens are started<< thus>> increasing thyroid requirements

modes.label: Time adverb after a verb
modes.description: Soon or now follows a verb or intensifier and gives timing.
modes.example: I suspect that the guys on the "Gadget Show" would run a feature on this USB stick PC pretty<< soon>>.
